attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a mouth that matches the source expression. Preserve the actual observed hair: bareheaded with a high receding or balding crown, short brown side-combed hair, dark eyebrows, and a narrow short brown or dark upper-lip moustache. Maintain the smooth clean chin and serious closed mouth. Keep the dark navy open subtly pinstriped civilian suit, white or pale shirt collar, and grey or blue-grey patterned necktie area beside the note. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening, with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct. Preserve the actual primary mild image-left angle, head roll, grey light, and crop. No cap, spectacles, chin beard, uniform, or hidden accessories.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED high receding/balding crown with short BROWN side-combed hair, actual dark eyebrow HAIR and narrow short BROWN/DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE, smooth clean chin and serious CLOSED mouth. DARK NAVY OPEN subtly pinstriped civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and GREY/BLUE-GREY patterned necktie area beside note. Preserve actual primary mild IMAGE-LEFT angle/head roll/grey light and crop. No cap, spectacles, chin beard, uniform or hidden accessories; tiny pattern count unspecified.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
